newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel edges higher with gasoil futures.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel edges higher with gasoil futures.

text.p: European jet fuel drifted higher on Wednesday on the back of stronger IPE gas oil futures, but physical jet activity was very muted.
April IPE gas oil closed $2 a tonne higher $167.25 a tonne on Tuesday after sharp falls on Monday.
"Jet is pretty stable, there's been very little change," said one trader.
Barges were heard offered at April IPE +$20 fob ARA while cargoes were pegged around $3 above barges for cif deliveries.
Traders said plentiful supplies in the barge market could pressure premiums lower.
